# FAQ-011 Engineering FAQ #11

Revision: Rev A

Q: What is the approved lubricant part number for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03)?
A: The lubricant part number for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is CFW-LUB-188. Use per procurement and storage procedures in SOP-P1-L1-01.

Q: What lubricant is specified for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02)?
A: The lubricant part number for Machining hydraulic forging press #2 (EQ-P1-L3-HP02) is CFW-LUB-497. Apply according to maintenance tasks referenced in SOP-P1-L3-04.

Q: Which lubricant is assigned to Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02)?
A: The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is CFW-LUB-930. Verify compatibility before field replenishment as outlined in SB-1029.

Q: What is the thermocouple calibration interval for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02)?
A: The thermocouple calibration interval for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) is 50 days. Record calibration events in the equipment log and follow SOP-P1-L3-04 for instrumentation checks.

Q: What is the coil inspection interval for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03)?
A: The coil inspection interval for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P1-L1-IH03) is 290 hours. Include coil inspection results in the repair dossier and reference SB-1029 for allowable wear criteria.

Related documents: SB-1029; SOP-P1-L1-01; SOP-P1-L3-04.
